own_scenes.desc: La violencia como martillo y no como espejo. Gustav Metzger, cuyas clases en la Ealing Art School inspiraron a Pete Townshend a destrozar guitarras, quería monumentos al poder humano de destruir toda vida, «a Hiroshima». En septiembre de 1966 organizó en Londres el Destruction in Art Symposium con cien artistas de dieciocho países (Ralph Ortiz destrozando un sillón de club, Hermann Nitsch eviscerando corderos, John Latham, Yoko Ono) en un solar bombardeado de Portobello Road; Metzger acabó acusado de exhibición indecente. Allan Kaprow enseñaba en disco a hacer un happening que no se supiera si era arte o vida, y Life dedicaba su portada al «arte LSD». Situaciones, provocaciones, autodestrucción, disturbios: la portada carnicera de los Beatles, la televisión quemada de los Provos y las guitarras rotas de los Who eran provocaciones del mismo orden, una exigencia de que el espectador reaccionara.

refs.q: Violence was a hot topic that high summer and early autumn.
refs.para: Violence was a hot topic that high summer and early autumn. The August edition of the avant-garde monthly Art and Artists featured a whole issue on the theme of ‘Auto Destructive’, with statements by Al Hansen, Gustav Metzger, Ralph Ortiz and Tony Cox. ‘We have among us a new generation of dissidents,’ wrote Kenneth Coutts-Smith in his introduction, ‘Violence’; ‘the beatniks of yesteryear have grown up and the hard core have turned into serious artists.’
refs.chapter: Septiembre: 7 And 7 Is: provocaciones, sombras y un nuevo lenguaje

refs.q: This was violence not as a mirror, but as a hammer
refs.para: This was violence not as a mirror, but as a hammer: ‘Auto-destructive monuments contain the brutality, the over-extended power, the nausea and unpredictability of our social systems. But there are other directions in our societies. There are forces that oppose war and work for disarmament. Auto-destructive art contains the contradictions of our situation. It is an instrument for probing the consciousness of masses of people on issues of peace and war.’
refs.chapter: Septiembre: 7 And 7 Is: provocaciones, sombras y un nuevo lenguaje

refs.q: It was all coming together: situations, Happenings, provocations, auto-destruction, riots, explosions
refs.para: It was all coming together: situations, Happenings, provocations, auto-destruction, riots, explosions – even the perceptual fission caused by LSD and the total immersion environments of the far-out discotheques. These manifestations might well have come from totally different intentions, but the end result was similar: a demand for the total involvement of spectator, listener, passerby. The divisions were down; passivity was no longer an option.
